chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Ubaydi, from al-Husayn ibn Yaqtin, from his father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about prayer among the graves, is it permissible? He said, 'There is no harm in it.'

key_terms.بَيْنَ الْقُبُورِ: among the graves / in a graveyard
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in a graveyard according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Ali ibn Yaqtin inquires of Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) regarding the validity of praying among graves, to which the Imam responds with 'la ba'sa' (there is no harm). This concise ruling establishes the permissibility of prayer in graveyards as a valid location for worship, distinguishing it from places of impurity or disrespect, and reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle that graveyards are not inherently invalid spaces for Salah.
